items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I was introduced to him by Jerry, the manager.

ctx.x: How did you run into Boyd at the beginning?

I was introduced to him by Jerry, the manager. I explained to you how my friend Jack Siegel--he wasn't my friend then, I didn't know him either, I was introduced to Jack as the writer of the song called 'Who Started Love' and he needed to get his song into Boyd's library because Boyd had a wire out of the hotel and Jack wanted to get his song on the air. The way to do it was to get somebody to write an arrangement to give to Boyd, and so, I don't recall exactly, but I think probably Jack paid for it, rather than…
arranger of Jack's song. Boyd was impressed with the chart and asked me if I would like to write for the band, and that's how it began. After a little while, I joined the band on piano.
